content: अवतरणम् .²1 Descending for bathing in water <ab>&c.</ab> गङ्गा˚, अप्सरस्तीर्थ˚; descending; or alighting (in general), coming down; स्तन्य˚. .²2 An incarnation; see अवतार, .²3 Crossing. .²4 Sudden disapperance. .²5 Steps or stairs leading to a river. .²6 A holy bathing place (तीर्थ). .²7 Translating from one language into another. .²8 Introduction. .²9 An extract, a quotation. .{@-मङ्गलम्@} A solemn reception.
